method: VLTI/GRAVITY single-field closure phases (K band) plus CRIRES+ radial velocities; orbit fitted with PMOIRED (frequentist) and Octofitter (Bayesian), Table 1. Closure phases only, 2.05-2.18 um.
flux_ratio_definition: f2/f1 = flux of Bb over Ba at 2.0 um (virgil's BinaryModelCartesian flux)
uncertainties: Table 1 1-sigma; PMOIRED values are frequentist, Octofitter values are posterior summaries. q has no quoted error.

conventions.omega: argument of periastron of the PRIMARY (Ba), as stated under Table 1; virgil uses the secondary's, = this + 180 deg
conventions.coordinates: +X East, +Y North, +Z away from the observer (Methods, Orbit fits); same as virgil's dra, ddec, dz
conventions.Omega: 'longitude of ascending node'; which node (approaching or receding) is not stated in the extracted text. virgil's Omega is the PA of the receding node: compare modulo 180 deg until checked
conventions.flux_ratio: f2/f1 = Bb/Ba at 2.0 um; virgil's BinaryModelCartesian flux

epochs.note: check against the OiDB file list (22 files) which nights are present

notes: secondary ~5 mas south of the primary, flux ratio ~0.5, moving ~4.6 mas/day nearly perpendicular to the separation over the 2.5 h window
Values copied from ~/data/eso_binaries/gravity/reference/xuan2024_table1.json, transcribed from the paper's Table 1 for the ESO binaries validation; fit_nights.py/LinearBinary is to be ported in O1.
